newsitem.title: UK: Total Gonfreville refinery plans big Sept shutdown.
newsitem.headline: Total Gonfreville refinery plans big Sept shutdown.

text.p: Total SA said on Tuesday that its refinery at Gonfreville, France would undergo a major five-yearly maintenance shutdown starting in September.

A Paris-based Total spokesman said "a large part" of the refinery, which has a crude distillation capacity of 309,000 barrels per day (bpd), would be affected by the month-long shutdown, "but not all of it."
He declined to say which units are to be taken down, the precise start date for the shutdown or any maintenance plans this year for Total's other French refineries at La Mede and Mardyck.
But he said the affected units would be shut "mainly" during September.
The Gonfreville refinery also includes a 31,000 bpd catalytic cracker, a 45,000 bpd catalytic reformer and a 27,000 bpd hydrotreating unit.

Total has already confirmed that the 39,0000 bpd hydrocracking unit at its Vlissingen (Flushing) refinery in the Netherlands is being shut for one-and-a-half weeks for a catalyst change in the second half August
